name: navigation
description: Places, directions, and EV trip planning — Google Maps and a Tesla Fleet trip planner, self-hosted at https://mcp.loup-peluso.com behind Cloudflare Access. Supply the Cloudflare Access service-token credentials to enable.

CF_ACCESS_CLIENT_ID.title: Cloudflare Access Client ID
CF_ACCESS_CLIENT_ID.description: The CF-Access-Client-Id for the mcp.loup-peluso.com Access service token (public identifier, ends in .access). Sent as a request header so Cloudflare Access lets the request through at the edge.

CF_ACCESS_CLIENT_SECRET.title: Cloudflare Access Client Secret
CF_ACCESS_CLIENT_SECRET.description: The CF-Access-Client-Secret paired with the Client ID. Stored in your system keychain, never written to the repo; maintainer copy is SOPS-encrypted in secrets/cloudflare-access.sops.json.
